title: Meta Maze
tagline: Meta maze is metaverse game where players can create their own maze puzzle and mint as NFT, DeFi coin store and that maze can be played by player OR other online player
description:
Meta maze is metaverse game where players can create their own maze puzzle and mint as NFT 1155, Decentralised Finance coin store and maze can be played by player OR other online player. Get daily reward spin and chance to win game token MMG ERC20

Features
- Multiplayer in metaverse game with voicechat and multiple blockchain support
- Create your maze as NFT 1155 and also purchase theme as NFT
- Play own puzzle game or other online available player
- Decentralized finance system with in-app items
- Daily chance to win game token ERC 20
how_its_made:
- Multiple blockchain to play as per user choice (NFT, DeFi, Game Token etc)
Aurora Testnet, Cronos - Testnet ,Polygon Mumbai - Testnet ,Skale Network Testnet ,Optimism Testnet
- IPFS/Filecoins used to host game, all NFT theme data and user created maze data including metadata and images
- Covalent used to get nft data from some blockchain
- Valist used to publish and host game
- NFTPort is used to store game maze data and retrieve
- EPNS is used to give push notification to players
- Quicknode is used to get wallet balance and gas price of polygon
- Remix IDE used to create smart contract for ERC-1155 NFT, ERC-20 game token and in-app purchase for coins
- Unity Game Engine and Web3 Library
